title: OSD UAP records - 25_Sky_View_Final_Draft
doc_notes: This document is an academic analysis of spatial patterns in publicly reported UAP sightings using NUFORC data, authored by researchers from the University of Utah and the Department of Defense.

incidents.summary: A deflating balloon was identified as a UAP sighting with high confidence.
The Roswell, New Mexico incident involving a multi-balloon project intended to detect Soviet nuclear tests.
incidents.quote: arguably the most popular UAP case in U.S. history
